provides: A ferry stage with fares and a bunk for the night; Thorn and Hissmir argue over the toll nightly.
An offering shelf above a pond where the wamasu that local people take for Haynekhtnamet hauls out on the bank.
Free water, paid beds and rope for travellers bound for Helstrom; the Many-Root Conclave tends a tree here.
Iron cakes lifted from the seep for road crews; a visitor may carry off as many as can be lifted; the diggers do not work the deep end.
The road's water point at the ford: a well and counter on one bank, a landing and a cart raft on the other, each charging for the same stop.
A hostile camp of unpaid Legion descendants who take a levy; the serjeant asks a stranger's business before drawing.
The handover of the Rose's dead for a carriage charge that the Chainbreakers pay and record; a family waits and a carrier wraps the bundles.
A sealed vault where the voriplasm rises when anyone comes close and leeches feed at the edge of the seep.
A wreck-salvage stall selling the past week's finds. The stage office is inherited and carries no pay; some salvage is held back from the count.
The lighter crews who move every cargo in the bay live aboard. The stop offers a lighter to Lilmoth, spare bunks, untaxed goods on the tradeship and a disputed mooring.
A Sithis temple held by the Nisswo of the Turning Path; the Nisswo take an outsider in for the right offering. A voriplasm lies in the flooded deep room.
A tribeless Naga camp at a blind bend that takes cargo, rarely kills and hands over a tally-stick receipt.
A work camp: the gang families, the egg clutch in the warm shed and two overseers who keep the gang's debts.
The Hist tree that the gang families follow, its minder, an elder who houses strangers and the households that stayed upriver.
A cave where a wamasu lies up among the dragged-in remains; ticks live in the bone scatter at the mouth.
Numbered pearl lots worked by diver families from Archon, a surface tender and the tally book of takings and drownings.
